submission.natural_language_explanation: The negative pole of L1/N2108 fires at a low, near-constant strength (about 0.17) on story-advancing content words in the middle of a clause: verbs of motion, action and change such as started, began, go, play, look, explore and stop, concrete scene nouns such as dove, town and city, and adverbs such as around and anymore. It stays inactive on punctuation, pronouns, auxiliary verbs, proper names, the most frequent function words, and on the formulaic story vocabulary such as said, mom, dog, cat and happy, and on most sentence-initial tokens.
